in_hebrew.name: Israien
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Helper of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Israien הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Israien is derived from the name Joshua which means 'Jehovah is salvation'. In the Bible, Joshua was a successor of Moses and led the Israelites into the Promised Land. As a helper of God, he demonstrated faith and courage during battles. This name carries a powerful reminder of trusting in God's guidance and strength.

in_greek.name: Israien
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Helper of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Israien είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. in_latin.name: Israien
in_latin.meaning: From Hebrew roots, symbolizing Israel's connection to God
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Israel ex radicibus Hebraicis, significans connectio Israelis cum Deo. Etymologia: nomen in Hebraeo exspectatio, promissio, et pactum cum Deo. In traditione Christiana, nomen Israel repraesentat fidem, perseverantiam, et dilectio Dei. Nomen in cultura Christiana varietate usitatum.
